name: MPI Master Node Parallel Rendering Workflow
definition: Coordinates parallel volume rendering by spawning slave processes via MPI, distributing transfer function and rendering parameters, receiving per-slice image data, assembling the full image, encoding to JPEG, and transmitting over TCP.
summary: This master-slave workflow coordinates parallel volume rendering by distributing parameters and assembling final images from per-slice fragments, distinguished by handling domain decomposition and concatenation within a pre-defined abstraction rather than the rendering loop.
